relations.subject: bucket:storage-backend-migration
relations.evidence: The two ways to trigger this rewrite are to perform a swap rebalance or a graceful failover followed by a full recovery.

relations.subject: storage-engine:magma
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - stated as an unconditional outcome of migrating to Magma, not a choice
relations.evidence: Migrating to a Magma bucket always results in a bucket with 1024 vBuckets, regardless of the number of vBuckets in the original bucket.

relations.subject: bucket:storage-backend-migration
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - the in-place migration path this page documents cannot change vBucket count; only the separate XDCR path can
relations.evidence: The backend migration described in this section does not support migrating between buckets with different numbers of vBuckets.

relations.subject: server:xdcr
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - condition: migrating between buckets with different vBucket counts
relations.evidence: To migrate between buckets with different number of vBuckets, you can use a local cross datacenter replication (XDCR).

relations.subject: bucket:storage-backend-migration
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - a bucket's ejection policy is one of only three parameters (ramQuota, evictionPolicy, storageBackend) editable during a migration, and can be changed in the same REST call as the storage backend itself
relations.evidence: When migrating a bucket between storage backends, you can edit only the bucket's [ramQuota](../../rest-api/rest-bucket-create.md#ramQuota), [evictionPolicy](../../rest-api/rest-bucket-create.md#evictionpolicy), and [storageBackend](../../rest-api/rest-bucket-create.md#storagebackend) parameters.

relations.subject: storage-engine:magma
relations.evidence: a Magma bucket must have a memory quota of at least 1 GB.

relations.subject: storage-engine:couchstore
relations.evidence: Couchstore's default threshold for fragmentation is 30%.

relations.subject: bucket:storage-backend-migration
relations.evidence: See [Auto-Compaction](../manage-settings/configure-compact-settings.md) to learn how to change the bucket's database fragmentation setting.

relations.evidence: See [Change Ejection Policy During a Backend Storage Migration](change-ejection-policy.md#change-during-migration) for more information.

notable_absence.finding: The page states that Server versions before 8.0 'do not support Magma buckets with 128 vBuckets', meaning this whole page's vocabulary (a Magma bucket at 128 vBuckets, as against the historical 1024-vBucket default) is itself new in 8.0 - a genuinely version-gated STRUCTURAL change (the number of vBuckets a bucket can have depended on release, not just on storage engine) that has no promoted predicate distinguishing it from an ordinary feature-availability fact. availableSince exists for 'this behavior holds since version V' claims; this is closer to 'this whole configuration axis did not exist before version V', which is a slightly different shape not previously distinguished in the registry.
